## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to model partitioning with a derived block metric that is additive via a simple prefix, and to present a workable DP with reconstruction.

## Key Concepts
- Partition DP
- Prefix sums
- Backtracking reconstruction
- Complexity: O(n^2 k)

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudocode for transitions
for i in 1..n:
  for t in 1..k:
    dp[i][t] = max_{j<i} dp[j][t-1] + (P[i]-P[j])
    back[i][t] = argmax_j
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you reconstruct the exact blocks from the DP table?
- Any edge cases when n < k or all increases are zero?
